Chat request with system message and user message

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful and concise assistant\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Hi\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
```
